approvalCard.action.continue: Continue the bot's work after it reached its message limit.
approvalCard.always.editHint: Edit the scope before saving. Leave a field empty to match anything; * matches any sequence of characters.
approvalCard.always.intro: Future matching actions for this bot will be allowed by this rule:
approvalCard.always.noTarget: No stable target could be derived for this action. As shown, the rule allows any arguments of this tool.
approvalCard.always.refusal.mismatch: This scope does not match the action you are answering.
approvalCard.always.refusal.truncated: The pattern ends in … from a shortened summary and would never match again. End it with * instead.
approvalCard.always.refusal.vaultExact: A credential use can be allowed again only for the same Vault entry, revision, operation and exact website.
approvalCard.always.warning.exactArgumen: This pattern has no *, so the rule matches only this exact wording again.
approvalCard.always.warning.exactInput: This rule matches only this exact input again.
approvalCard.ask.label: Tell {bot} what to do instead, or ask it something. The action is not taken; the bot reads your words and continues from there.
approvalCard.askMore: @{bot} before {target}: what is this for, what will it change, and is there a way that needs no approval?
approvalCard.egressWhy: {host} is not on this workspace's allowed list. Allowing it adds the site for every bot on this computer.
approvalCard.redirect: Tell it what to do instead
approvalCard.redirect.actionTitle: Tell the bot what to do instead; it rethinks without taking this action
approvalCard.redirect.siteTitle: Tell the bot what to do instead; it rethinks without opening the site
approvalCard.risk.continuation: This may use more time and budget.
approvalCard.risk.externalChange: This can change something outside Deskmates.
approvalCard.risk.newSite: This lets every bot in the workspace contact a new site.
approvalCard.risk.unclassified: Deskmates does not recognize this action, so a person must review it.
approvalCard.summaryUnavailable: Summary unavailable. Review the action details before deciding.
approvalCard.unclassifiedWhy: No tier table names this tool, so it asks by default.
approvalCard.wait.live: Waiting for your approval. This work pauses in {remaining} unless someone decides.
approvalCard.wait.parked: Paused waiting for you. The work continues after someone decides.
approvalCard.wait.parking: The live wait ended. This work is pausing until someone decides.
approvals.empty.body: Work waiting for a person will show up here.
approvals.empty.nextDoes: decide a request here or in its chat when a bot asks before an external action
approvals.empty.title: Nothing pending
approvals.expiry.hint: A request nobody decides in this time is not done, and the bot is told so. People get one reminder before then.
approvals.expiry.label: Expire undecided requests after
approvals.intro: Actions a Bot may not take on its own. Deciding here is the same as deciding in the chat; any chat member can answer.
approvals.mode.approveAll.hint: Every action that would ask is allowed without asking anyone, including deletions, permission changes and new sites. A Bot that reaches its message limit continues on its own. Private addresses stay blocked, and budget and loop limits still apply. Every allowance is recorded.
approvals.mode.automatic.hint: An independent AI reviewer answers requests first, including scheduled work and browser actions, so Bots do not wait for someone to be online. Deleting, changing permissions, opening new sites and actions that carry credentials still wait for a person. Every decision is recorded.
approvals.mode.badge.title: This workspace allows every action that would ask, without asking anyone.
approvals.mode.legend: Who answers a request that needs approval
approvals.mode.manual.hint: Every request waits for a person or a teammate bot in the chat.
approvals.mode.title: Approvals
approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.totalRequests: {count} pending requests in {count, plural, one {this group} other {these groups}}.
approvals.workspaceLookupFailed: Could not load workspace permissions. Some allow options are unavailable until this is retried.
integrationApprovalPreview.truncated: Preview truncated. Review the complete content before allowing.
